versions.changelog:
- Clarified routing: now explicitly mention use of `p-video-2-pro-reference` for reference-locked identity, style, motion, or timing (image/video/audio, 480p/768p).
- Updated When NOT to use section: added `p-video-2-pro-reference` and guidance for reference-guided cinematic cases.
- Adjusted agent usage description to highlight differences between soundtrack import and reference-driven generation.
- Removed deprecated file: `skill-card.md`.

- Version updated to 1.0.14 in SKILL.md.
- Minor documentation/content changes in SKILL.md.
- Removed: skill-card.md file.

- Clarified the distinction between `p-video-2` and the new `p-video-2-pro` skill, including routing and feature differences (cinematic/HD, generated/imported audio).
- Updated skill boundaries and "When NOT to use" to direct cinematic or generated-audio use cases to `p-video-2-pro`.
- Refined the skill description to emphasize 1080p clips, imported audio support, and not for fully cinematic or talking-head clips.
- Minor guidance improvements for prompt craft and agent workflow.
- Removed redundant or legacy documentation file (`skill-card.md`).

p-video-2 v1.0.12

- Clarified skill routing: choose `p-video-2` for high-quality, tightly-synced short clips; use alternative skills for multi-scene, talking-head, or direct video editing use cases.
- Expanded section on prerequisites and required companion skills for prompt drafting, audio, and API calls.
- Detailed agent workflow for intake, prompt crafting, and user clarification, emphasizing fresh, beat-matched prompts per request.
- Added specific boundaries and “when not to use” chart to prevent out-of-scope requests and guide users to more suitable skills.
- Updated HTTP API examples for uploading assets, initiating predictions, and managing visual transition shots.
- Refined pricing and rate limits per resolution and draft status in API section.
